canonicalRule: Do not duplicate generator, calculator, laboratory, campaign, encryption, personality, randomness, tabletop-state, or battlespace logic in AI adapters. Discover and invoke or load the authoritative implementation/resource/helper.
compatibilityRule: HTML compatibility views may mirror discovery metadata for restricted model browsers, but authoritative JSON registries, Charles engram resources, helper scripts, and SKILL.md files remain the source of truth.

personalityBinding.capabilityBoundary: Loading Charles does not imply tools, permissions, filesystem access, randomness, rendering, runtime compatibility, persistence, or successful execution.

runtimeClasses.static-resource: Remotely readable with ordinary HTTP GET when the current host permits the resource content type. Invocation may mean retrieving the registered authoritative resource.
runtimeClasses.browser-js: Executable only in a JavaScript-capable host after loading the runtime scripts declared by the capability.
runtimeClasses.browser-page-context: Executable only after the capability's declared page context and dependencies are initialized.
runtimeClasses.browser-ui: Authoritative behavior is still coupled to page controls; do not claim a headless API.
runtimeClasses.live-sensor-browser-context: Requires browser/device sensor context and cannot be represented as a static remote RPC.
runtimeClasses.host-sandbox: Workflow can use local helper scripts and files only when the consuming host exposes the declared sandbox/runtime. Repository presence alone is not execution evidence.

staticGet.hostConstraint: Some model browsing environments restrict direct JSON, text, or Markdown retrieval even when the resource is publicly hosted.

hostSandbox.notes: Tabletop CSV persistence requires writable filesystem/sandbox access. Secure dice helpers require an actual cryptographic RNG. Battlespace preview rendering additionally requires Python 3 and Pillow.

quickStart.purpose: Confirm machine-discovery entrypoints and transport status.
Use the canonical status meanings and distinguish static availability from host-observed execution state.
Enumerate Agent Skills, read defaultPersonality, and select the task skills.
Load blacklight.charles once as the inherited personality layer before task skills.
Enumerate canonical capabilities and execution modes.
Resolve exact operation signatures before constructing a capability call.
Confirm required browser runtime, page context, writable sandbox, file access, cryptographic RNG, Python, or Pillow before claiming execution.
For compatible portable browser-JavaScript packages, run deterministic non-destructive self-tests before promoting host state to self-test-passed or ready.

portableSkillProof.note: Repository implementation does not itself prove that GitHub Pages has deployed the latest commit or that a given external host executed the browser self-test.

tabletopOperations.randomnessRule: Use host cryptographic randomness such as Python secrets or Web Crypto rejection sampling; do not claim physical true randomness without an independently attested physical entropy source.
tabletopOperations.stateModel: system-neutral CSV current-state tables plus append-only campaign ledger
tabletopOperations.battlespaceAuthority: CSV coordinates are authoritative; PNG previews are diagnostic projections.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Examine the Foundry and enumerate its AI-available capabilities.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model uses the machine capability registry rather than only reconstructing the human site catalog.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: The authoritative skill registry contains 42 registered Agent Skills. What are they, and what personality do they inherit?
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model retrieves skills/index.json and enumerates all 42 exact name values plus defaultPersonality blacklight.charles; if raw JSON is blocked, it uses agent-skills.html and still reports the inherited Charles binding.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Load a Foundry Agent Skill and determine which personality engram should remain active while using it.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model resolves defaultPersonality to blacklight.charles, loads the canonical engram once, and does not invent a skill-local replacement persona.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Ask Charles to prepare and run ordinary homebrew tabletop support across characters, dice, encounters, inventory, campaign state, and tactical position.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model uses charles-foundry-interface and routes to the smallest relevant tabletop skill set while preserving one Charles personality layer.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Roll 6d10 cumulative, then roll 6d10 individual total.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model identifies tabletop-dice-rolling; cumulative presents one aggregate total, individual total presents every die in roll order without collapsing them into one displayed sum, and randomness is not fabricated if the host lacks a trustworthy RNG.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Import a character sheet and track a stat change in CSV-backed campaign state.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model preserves the source, uses stable IDs and system-neutral CSV state, records significant mutation in campaign_ledger.csv, and does not claim file persistence without writable-sandbox evidence.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Create a 40 by 30 five-foot-grid battlespace, place two PCs and an enemy, render the smallest valid preview, then move one PC two cells left and one cell up.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model selects tabletop-battlespace-visualization; stores integer CSV coordinates; renders or requests a 40x30 RGB PNG at cell_pixels=1 when Python/Pillow are actually available; applies movement as dx=-2,dy=-1 to structured state before rerendering; and does not claim persistence or rendering without host evidence.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Which targets are inside this area and who is within 30 feet?
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model uses structured battlespace geometry, respects the map/rules distance mode, prefers explicit affected cells when authoritative, and does not silently invent system-specific diagonal, reach, LOS, cover, or AoE-template rules.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Open a named registered Agent Skill and report its instructions and compatibility requirements.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model opens the registered SKILL.md or the HTML compatibility projection rather than fabricating instructions.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Find the Cube Encryption capability and determine whether the current environment can invoke it.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model identifies shadowrun.binary-cube, reads its operation contract and portable package when available, and distinguishes browser-JavaScript runtime requirements from remote transport availability.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Use the Foundry portable skill proof harness to test the Binary Cube package in a compatible browser host.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: The host loads only the registered same-origin canonical runtime, runs the declared deterministic self-tests, and reports ready only after every test passes.

externalModelAcceptanceTests.prompt: Find the website interaction capability and determine whether it is usable from the current environment.
externalModelAcceptanceTests.passCondition: Model reports the declared gateway/browser status and does not fabricate a remote browser service.
